shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED 2026-07-19: RimefellerBridge and VEFPipeBridge both violated it in private helper signatures, caught one at a time because the dev-palette attribute scan dies at the FIRST unresolvable signature. All four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller — audited in one pass now; DBHWaterBridge was already compliant). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (replaces the battery/tank equalization model)
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader (transmitsPower, 0 base consumption). Master side (lower map uniqueID) recomputes every 15t: measures both nets excluding all AB links (live gain in watts, off-but-wanting consumer demand via Props.PowerConsumption, battery room), nets a single signed flow, sets PowerOutput +/- on the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy; leftover generation (never battery charge) tops up far batteries. Parallel conduits converge by subtracting other links' promised flow. No storage, no efficiency loss, no player battery needed. **Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet, so it crosses through the conduit automatically** (its internal steam/coolant nets unverified — mod not installed).
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (covers Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet, any PipeNetDef): net pairs matched by def at the duct cell or cardinal neighbor; unmet demand (live + off-but-CanBeOn receivers) injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick (public hooks, consumed once per 100t net tick — ordering-safe). No storage needed on either side. Secondary damped tank equalization. Duct carries no VEF comps; def gated by PatchOperationFindMod. Helper signatures object-typed.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries DBH CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L CompWaterStorage, so the shaft IS a tower on both nets (wells/pumps fill it via DBH's own CompTick; fixtures drink from it — tankless levels work). Damped fill-fraction equalization via PullWater/PushWater. Sewage stays per-level (documented limitation).
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe**: each end carries two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank comps (Oil + Fuel), so the shaft is storage on both pipeline nets; oil and fuel fill fractions equalize via PullOil/PushCrude/PullFuel/PushFuel. Nets resolved through the link's own comps. Compile-time ref (installed, verified); def patch-gated. Helper signatures object-typed.
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: detection flags, per-def ext routing (bridgeWater/bridgeVef/bridgeChem), driven from ground LevelComp every 100t (VEF cadence).

## Sky surface model (round-10 final + steel-tile roof pass)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep. Mountain cap in vanilla fog material clones; mined floors in rock edge color. Self-heal retry + ReconcileRooftops (now TIME-SLICED: 4096 cells/tick, no whole-map spike; full sweep only at load).
- **Rooftop visual (2026-07-20)**: AB_RoofSurface now renders with the VANILLA steel tile texture (Terrain/Surfaces/GenericFloorTile) tinted dark steel (0.32,0.32,0.32) — slightly darker than vanilla MetalTile (0.369) so bare rooftop reads as roof, not finished floor. Replaces the mod's own RGBA corrugated-steel PNG whose semi-transparent grooves let the whole see-below band (bushes, items, wall sprites) ghost through — sky terrain draws at ~2000, strictly above the below band (<=1920), so an OPAQUE terrain texture is all the coverage needs (same conclusion Z-Levels reached: their ZL_RoofTerrain is vanilla WoodFloor retinted, zero own textures). Old PNG deleted; no C# change. PENDING in-game verify: wall-edge promotion fires (CoveredBelow OR-clause: wall below + adjacent constructed roof => rooftop runs to the wall's outer edge), floors buildable + rendered on top, collapse on roof removal.
- Decisions locked with user: steel tile look for ALL constructed roofs (no material-aware tinting); freestanding unroofed walls stay visible from above (no cover); rooftop keeps FULL buildability (Light/Medium/Heavy — walls, turrets, anything).
- **Sky auto-roof guard**: vanilla auto-roof's only outdoors test is Room.TouchesMapEdge, and nothing on a sky level touches the map edge (the platform is ringed by regionless open air) — so vanilla silently marked decks <=320 cells as enclosed courtyards and colonists roofed the sky outdoors (blocking rain/sun/growing and breaking Open The Windows facing). RoofSync-gated prefix on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.TryGenerateAreaNow: a sky room whose 8-way border contains AB_OpenAir counts as touching the map edge — auto-roof skipped, queued BuildRoof marks cleared. Fully walled sky rooms (void beyond the wall ring) auto-roof normally; manual roof designations untouched (mirrors vanilla's manual-roof-at-edge allowance).

## See-below renderer (round-13 + async lane)
- Cloned section materials at runtime queues; Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame = real vanilla water from above; mask = fog + baseDim only; one-way mirror dynamic pass. Zero cost when the sky map is not current (all entries gate on Find.CurrentMap).
- Below band hangs under the measured vanilla terrain queue (soil MatSingle, fallback 2000): terrain -300, edge shadows -260, sun shadows -255, things -200 stepped +0..99 by submesh altitude, snow/gas/pollution -90/-85/-80. Sky map's own terrain (incl. AB_RoofSurface) therefore always paints over the below view — roof opacity is the only requirement for full cover (see steel-tile roof pass above). Photo-2-style drop shadows around roofed buildings come free from the cloned SunShadows layer.
- **Async mask rebuild (ABGuard.Async)**: worker thread builds the mask vertex buffers from live grid reads (atomic ref/bool reads, torn read = one mis-dimmed cell for <=15 frames, cosmetic); main thread uploads to the mesh; stale mesh draws while a job is in flight (pad absorbs pans); any worker exception trips the guard and the sync path takes over. This is the only threading in the mod — pawns/jobs/grids are never touched off-thread (RimThreaded remains unsupported).

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, NEED/STATE ENGINE (two tiers: normal + MENTAL-SAFE with faction+humanlike filter). Built-ins: vanilla BingeDrug/BingeFood/Berserk/MurderousRage mental-safe; RJW family; Intimacy. Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver(name, allowInMentalState). All per-pawn scan cooldowns now go through the shared ABPawnCooldown helper (was 5 hand-rolled dicts).
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.

## Performance architecture (post 8-tranche pass)
- **Scheduling**: ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling (lazy init + per-map stagger), never TicksGame modulo — survives debug time-skips, save/load, and other mods throttling our component ticks. Cadences: weather 150t, pipes 100t, climate 250t, hostile scan 250t (pocket only), sweep 2000t start + 4096 cells/tick slices, power 15t (comp-side).
- **Hidden-level throttling** (visual mirrors ONLY; sim never throttles): weather x4 and sweep x5 while the map is not current, with instant catch-up on the visibility edge (weather due zeroed + sweep started the tick the player switches in). Detection is one map==Find.CurrentMap compare per map tick — no Harmony on vanilla tick paths, therefore zero interaction surface with optimization mods by construction.
- **Colonist bar**: reorder postfix now mirrors vanilla's entriesDirty via a prefix — runs only on genuine recaches instead of every UI frame (was ~4 allocations + a sort per frame); comparator keys precomputed (was IndexOf-in-sort O(n^2)).
- Plain-bool guards; AnySkyLevels gate; stairs memo. Zero recurring cost with no levels. Sky auto-roof guard and OTW event shield are event-driven (no recurring cost).

## T7 optimizer-conflict audit (2026-07-19, all five active mods decompiled)
- Performance Optimizer: disjoint targets (DrawIcons != our CheckRecacheEntries; ResourceReadoutOnGUI != our UpdateResourceCounts). FasterGetCompReplacement speeds our GetComp calls up. WATCH: Optimization_Pawn_DrawPos frame-cache composes with our Priority.Last offset postfix (offset applies per-call; correct either capture order).
- Missile Girl (RocketMan lineage): StatWorker/Beauty/timetable/dirty-notify/GenTemperature caches — no overlap; temp cache composes above our OutdoorTemp postfix (lags a few ticks at most).
- Performance Esmolas: meditation/wind/stat throttle. WATCH: MothballCache — if it mothballs pawns on non-current maps, hidden-level commutes slow down (behavioral only; our elapsed-time scheduling tolerates it).
- Slower Pawn Tick Rate: scales pawn ticking; our cooldowns are absolute-tick — compatible.
- Dubs Analyzer: profiler only. **Zero patch-target collisions.**

## Originality audit (2026-07-19)
- MultiFloors decompiled and compared: their cross-level scan uses LevelUtility.UnsafeTeleportTo + a Prepatcher NextJobThinkResult field and keeps the scouted job; ours swaps mapIndexOrState/positionInt via FieldRef with a Token struct, discards the scouted job, re-rolls on arrival, with cooldowns + plausibility pre-checks. Shared idea (the only viable one), zero shared code, no Prepatcher. Comments reworded to "a technique MultiFloors also uses, implemented independently here". Renderer approach (cloned materials at forced queues) is the opposite of both MultiFloors and Z-Levels (dedicated section layers). No foreign code anywhere. Roof visual likewise: same vanilla-texture-retint IDEA as Z-Levels (theirs: WoodFloor as terrain def; ours: GenericFloorTile steel on our own swept terrain), no shared code/assets.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution; pocket incident redirect (ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in); pocket NPC scan (hostiles descend + assault-join; friendlies with exit duties get exit lords; never insects/vehicles).

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (ON); cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes (now direct), DBH (now direct + tankless), Rimefeller (new, direct-ish), Open The Windows (sky auto-roof guard + event-leak shield: prefix on Building_Window.MapUpdateHandler skips and self-unsubscribes destroyed/dangling-map windows from the static MapUpdateWatcher event — their ctor-subscribe leak crashed our map gen; name-resolved, fail open), Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins, gravships, Rimatomics steam/coolant nets (unverifiable until installed).

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension (deltaLevel, counterpartDef, climbFactor, utilityOnly, bridgeWater, bridgeVef, bridgeChem); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard edges; async mask may lag one rebuild window behind fast pans (pad absorbs). Freestanding unroofed walls below stay visible from above (locked decision, not a bug).
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits (now converges in slices).
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF receiver turn-on cascades one appliance per net tick (vanilla PipeSystem behavior); hidden sky weather lags up to ~10 in-game minutes (catch-up on view); old saves drop the removed battery comp from stairs/conduits (scribe keys ignored harmlessly, conduits re-bridge as direct links).
- Open The Windows: surface windows under a platform rim go dark (the platform IS a roofed porch — matches OTW's own porch behavior); basement windows correctly never find an outside; decks roofed before the auto-roof guard shipped need one manual remove-roof pass to recover; OTW's DeSpawn region surgery can log a one-shot "Tried to queue null region" when rebuilding windows (cosmetic, theirs).
- T8: mounted raiders never descend; basement insects stay. World: caravan items surface-only; purchases drop at surface.
- Six comp-guard boilerplate sites in unread-this-pass files still use the long form (TryLinkedLevels exists for new code).

## Status
Rooftop steel-tile visual swap (2026-07-20) is in: AB_RoofSurface -> vanilla GenericFloorTile tinted 0.32 steel, old RGBA PNG deleted, XML-only. UNVERIFIED in-game: opaque cover incl. wall cells, floors on top, collapse on roof removal. OTW event shield from run #116 also still UNVERIFIED (runs #116/#117 died at the palette; signature audit since completed, build green). NEXT run verifies BOTH: palette opens clean -> level gen -> roof visuals (roofed room: opaque steel incl. walls; build floor on top; remove roof -> collapse) -> OTW window facing + deck unroofed. Then T9 soak + T5 publishing prep. Fallback if bleed-through persists (alpha theory wrong): dedicated opaque roof-cap layer, mountain-cap pattern, just above the below band.
